name: org_graph_stale_facts
description: List which of the given people's memberships and facts are stale: Espalia holds them and nobody has changed or confirmed them within the tenant's threshold. Each row has the person id, the fact ("membership", or a fact such as "site" or "title"), the unit id for a membership, the day it was last checked and the id of whoever checked it. Oldest first. A fact an HRIS holds is never stale, since each sync confirms it. Admins only while the Org Graph is unfinished.
